description_en: Queries logs of different types for an Elasticsearch instance
description_zh: 查看ES实例不同类型的日志
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-search-log --instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --type INSTANCELOG --query host:172.16.00.00_AND_content:netty --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSearchLog

parameters.help_en:
The log type. Valid values:
INSTANCELOG: primary log.
SEARCHSLOW: searching slow log.
INDEXINGSLOW: indexing slow log.
JVMLOG: GC log.
ES_SEARCH_ACCESS_LOG: Elasticsearch access log.
AUDIT: audit log.

For limits on viewing logs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72026.html
parameters.help_zh:
日志类型。可选值：
INSTANCELOG：主日志。
SEARCHSLOW：searching慢日志。
INDEXINGSLOW：indexing慢日志。
JVMLOG：GC日志。
ES_SEARCH_ACCESS_LOG：ES访问日志。
AUDIT：审计日志。

查看日志的相关限制信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72026.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the log, in milliseconds. The value must be within the last 7 days. If this parameter is not specified, all logs within the range of [current time - 7 days, endTime] are queried
parameters.help_zh: 日志开始时间戳，单位：毫秒。必须为最近7天内的时间，如果不填会查询[当前时间-7天,endTime]范围内的所有日志
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the log, in milliseconds. The value must be within the last 7 days. Specify this parameter. If this parameter is not specified, an empty result is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志结束时间戳，单位：毫秒。必须为最近7天内的时间，建议填写，如果不填返回结果为空
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the plugin list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 插件列表的页码。起始值：1，默认值：1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：50
parameters.name: size

X-Total-Count.description_en: The total number of records for the instance

Result.description_en: The list of logs returned by the request

content.description_en: The detailed log content. This field has been migrated to the contentCollection field
content.description_zh: 日志详细内容。已迁移至contentCollection字段中

contentCollection.description_en: The log details. Different log types return different content fields
contentCollection.description_zh: 日志详细信息。不同的日志类型，返回不同的内容字段
contentCollection.example: {"level": "info", "host": "192.168.**.**", "time": "2019-03-18T08:16:12.741Z","content": "[o.e.c.r.a.AllocationService] [MnNASM_] Cluster health status changed from [YELLOW] to [GREEN] (reason: [shards started [[my_index][3]] ...])."}

host.description_en: The IP address of the node that generated the log
host.description_zh: 生成日志的节点的IP地址

level.description_en:
The log level. Valid values:

warn: warning log
info: information log
error: error log
trace: trace log
debug: debug log

The level information has been migrated to the contentCollection field
level.description_zh:
日志等级。取值包括：

warn：警告日志
info：信息日志
error：错误日志
trace：跟踪日志
debug：调试日志

level信息已迁移至contentCollection字段中

timestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the log was generated, in milliseconds
timestamp.description_zh: 日志生成的时间戳，单位为ms
